title: Settings
intro: Saved values are stored on the server and override environment variables. Reset a field to go back to its environment or default value.
wall: Stats wall for a big screen:
redisHelp: Valkey (or Redis, which speaks the same protocol) is configured with the REDIS_* environment variables.
secretUnreadable: Saved, but it doesn't open with the current secret key. Enter it again.
themeHint: The colours below apply when Theme is Custom.
contrastLow: Accent on background: {{ratio}}:1. Below 3:1, buttons and focus rings will be hard to see.
savedTheme: Saved. Reloading to show the new theme…

presets.rows: A letter per row: A-1, A-2 … then B-1, B-2
presets.block: Block name and a number: A-1 to A-24

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.desc: The floor plan (switches, positions, seat blocks, cables, patch panels, uplinks, port areas and power) and the saved settings, including the theme. API tokens, webhook URLs, accounts and check-ins are never in a backup, and a restore leaves them as they are.
backup.notJson: That file is not JSON. Pick a file made with "Download backup".
backup.notBackup: That file is not a Floorbit backup.
backup.summary: {{name}}{{made}}: {{switches}}, {{blocks}} and {{settings}}. Restoring replaces the current floor plan and those settings for everyone.
backup.skipped_one: Skipped {{count}} setting this version doesn't know.
backup.skipped_other: Skipped {{count}} settings this version doesn't know.
backup.kept: This backup is from an older version and has no cables, patch panels, uplinks, port areas or power: those were left as they are.

s3.title: Backups in S3
s3.desc: The same backup as above, uploaded to an S3 bucket on a schedule. Restore or download any of them here.
s3.off: No bucket is set up yet.
s3.none: No backups in the bucket yet.
s3.confirm: Restore the backup from {{when}}? It replaces the current floor plan and its settings for everyone.

netbox.title: NetBox
netbox.desc: Source of the switch inventory. Leave the URL or token empty to place switches manually.

librenms.title: LibreNMS
librenms.desc: Live switch status, port statistics and IP to switch-port resolution for seats.

cache.title: Caching
cache.desc: How long LibreNMS lookups are kept in Valkey before they are fetched again.

display.title: Display defaults
display.desc: Defaults for switches that have no per-device setting of their own.

signin.title: Discord sign-in
signin.desc: A "Sign in with Discord" button on the sign-in page. Create an application at discord.com/developers, add <this site>/auth/discord/callback as an OAuth2 redirect (set Public URL under General when the app runs behind a proxy) and paste its client ID and secret here. Without a server, only accounts linked on the Users page can use it.

public.title: Attendee pages
public.desc: Pages for attendees, open without an account. They show seat numbers only: no nicks, addresses, switches or ports.

speedtest.title: Speed tests
speedtest.desc: The speed test on the seat help page. Every test streams from this server, so these limits keep a hall full of tests from taking its threads and its uplink.

metrics.title: Prometheus metrics
metrics.desc: GET /api/metrics in the Prometheus text format, for a NOC Grafana: seats online, problems, incidents and switches, counted per hall. No seats, nicks or addresses. Scrape it with an API token (Settings > API) that has a read-only viewer role.

floorplan.title: Floor plan
floorplan.desc: Defaults for new seat blocks in the floor plan editor. Every block draws its seats at the same size and spacing; a block can still be set differently in its details.

cabling.title: Cabling
cabling.desc: Cables drawn on the floor plan: LAN and fiber from switch ports to seats, uplinks, and power.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: The look of every page. A screen can pick its own preset with ?theme= (for example /kiosk?theme=kiosk); ?theme=default goes back to this one.

netbox_device_roles.label: Device roles
netbox_device_roles.help: Comma-separated NetBox role slugs to import as switches.

librenms_fdb_exclude.label: Ignored port names
librenms_fdb_exclude.help: When locating a MAC address, ports whose name contains any of these are skipped (uplinks, LAGs, SVIs).

cache_ttl_resolve.label: Seat resolution TTL
cache_ttl_resolve.help: How long an IP to switch-port result is reused.

signin_discord_guild_id.label: Server ID
signin_discord_guild_id.help: Members of this Discord server can sign in, and get an account on their first sign-in. Right-click the server in Discord (developer mode on) and copy its ID.

signin_discord_admin_roles.label: Admin roles
signin_discord_admin_roles.help: Comma-separated Discord role IDs whose members become admins.

signin_discord_editor_roles.label: Editor roles
signin_discord_editor_roles.help: Role IDs whose members become editors.

signin_discord_viewer_roles.label: Viewer roles
signin_discord_viewer_roles.help: Role IDs whose members become viewers. With all three role lists empty, every member of the server can sign in as a viewer; otherwise members without one of these roles are refused. The role is set on the first sign-in; change it on the Users page later.

public_status_page.label: Network status page
public_status_page.help: /status tells attendees whether the network is fine, which areas an outage hits, and the crew's updates. Off by default.

public_stats_wall.label: Stats wall
public_stats_wall.help: /wall shows fun facts about the event for a big screen (/wall?screen=1) and phones: data downloaded, the bandwidth peak, top games, seats online. Hall-wide and per seat block only. Off by default.

public_schedule.label: Schedule and countdown
public_schedule.help: /agenda shows the countdown to the event, what is on now and next, and the programme, for big screens (/agenda?screen=1) and phones. Off by default.

floorplan_reverse_numbers.label: Seat 1 on the right
floorplan_reverse_numbers.help: Number the seats from the right as seen on the plan, instead of from the left.

floorplan_block_gap.label: Room between copied blocks
floorplan_block_gap.help: When several blocks are made at once, the space between one and the next, in % of the plan.

cabling_auto.label: Draw cables automatically
cabling_auto.help: Draw a cable from the switch to every seat whose port is known (from the cables and the port descriptions), routed along the seat blocks. Turn it off when seats are patched through panels and draw the cables you want with the Cable tool instead.

theme_name.label: Event name
theme_name.help: Shown in the top bar and as the kiosk heading. Empty shows the Floorbit logo.

theme_logo.label: Event logo
theme_logo.help: SVG, PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 256 KB. Replaces the Floorbit logo in the top bar; the powered-by footer stays.

theme_accent.label: Accent colour
theme_accent.help: Buttons, links and focus. Status colours (up, down, warning) never change.

theme_background.label: Background
theme_background.help: A dark background gives a dark-only theme, a light one a light-only theme.

theme_surface.label: Panels
theme_surface.help: Empty: a shade of the background.

theme_text.label: Text
theme_text.help: Empty: near white or near black, by background.

speedtest_enabled.label: Speed test on the help page
speedtest_enabled.help: Off hides the button on the seat help page and refuses every test.

speedtest_max_running.label: Streams at once
speedtest_max_running.help: Downloads and uploads running at the same time, over all seats. Each holds a server thread.

speedtest_test_mb.label: Data per test
speedtest_test_mb.help: What one test may move, download and upload together. Enough for a gigabit seat.

speedtest_seat_minutes.label: One test per seat every
speedtest_seat_minutes.help: 0 lets a seat test as often as it likes.

speedtest_max_mbps.label: Speed cap per stream
speedtest_max_mbps.help: 0 for no cap. With the default, a gigabit seat still measures in full.

pickColour: Pick a colour from the screen

nav.whereFrom: A value saved here wins over its environment variable; clear it to go back to the environment or the default. The database, Valkey, keys and time zone are set in the environment only.
